clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa, Seer Ravenfeather guides young tauren in the ways of the spirits and Mulgore's land.

At Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather teaches young tauren who have chosen the shamanic path. Red Cloud Mesa is a sacred proving ground, and she prepares new practitioners for their duties before they venture farther into Mulgore. She teaches the rites that let them commune with elemental forces and honor the Earth Mother.

Seer Ravenfeather guides new shamans through their first spiritual steps and the traditional Call of Earth rite. Under her guidance, initiates prepare ceremonial saptas and seek communion with the earthen spirits among the mesa's stony outcrops. The bond they forge anchors their elemental magic.
